svg.title: Five telemetry sources show small signals
svg.desc: Use five separately titled telemetry surfaces with small incomplete signals. Different record types remain recognizable before correlation combines their significance. Visual distinction: A solid tiled network wall with disconnected cable ends. Indicates unavailable reach, not a decision awaiting human approval.
